MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Lifestyle and substance use variables extracted from a general health questionnaire administered in Norwegian prior to EEG recording.

medication_use.Description: Indicates whether the participant uses any prescription or over-the-counter medications.

daily_nicotine.Description: Indicates whether the participant uses nicotine products daily.

nicotine_type.Description: Type of nicotine product used daily. Empty if daily_nicotine = 2.

alcohol_units.Description: Self-reported average number of alcohol units consumed per week. One unit is defined as one glass of wine or 0.33 litres of beer.

drugs_bin.Description: Indicates whether the participant has used recreational drugs in the past six months.

drug_freq.Description: Frequency of recreational drug use. Empty if drugs_bin = 2.
